text:
maria: Quick sync  we need a tight benchmark narrative for launch: two hero visuals (cost curve + stability map), one 6s animated social clip, and a single-page PDF. Keep claims quantifiable and footnoted.

ajay: Agreed. Hero visuals: (1) $/1M tokens vs QPS with baseline, quantized, and cached+batching lines; (2) Stability map = P95 heatmap across seq_len x QPS to show safe regions.

sam: For the stability map slice seq_len into 64/256/1024. Annotate where graceful degradation happens. Social animation: needle moving across cost curve to show tradeoffs.

jen: Messaging variants to A/B: A) "Reduce inference spend up to 60%" B) "Keep P95 steady as traffic spikes" C) Combined. CTA: "Run this benchmark on your workload."

eli: I'll draft the one-pager and the demo flow. Need a compact CSV with model, seq_len, tokens/sec, $/1M, p50/p95/p99 to build charts. @ajay drop numbers.

ajay: Pasting example rows (full CSV on benchbot): rw-opt-8b,64,62000,9.1,12,36,120; rw-opt-8b-q4_0,64,79000,6.8,14,40,140; rw-opt-8b-cached,64,98000,4.9,13,38,125; rw-opt-8b,256,48000,12.4,15,48,210

noah: For inbound routing: leads that run the benchmark and select >100k monthly tokens go to AE/Solutions. Add hidden numeric field on the form for "expected_monthly_tokens".

jen: Landing page form fields: email, company, expected_monthly_tokens (options: <10k,10-100k,100k+), consent checkbox. Two ad variations for LI: "Cut inference bills, not SLA" and "Predictable P95 at burst loads".

maria: Design/visual rules: consistent axis ranges, colorblind-safe palette, clear annotations where cache/batching kick in (200-800 QPS). Include a small table with % cost delta vs baseline in the deck. Footnote sources.

sam: Webinar outline: 10m why economics matter, 12m live benchmark walkthrough (heatmap + cost curve), 8m customer vignette, 10m Q&A. Title option: "Serving LLMs: predictable economics at scale."

ajay: Small docs snippet for smoke test: ```bash
curl -s https://api.redwood.com/v1/ping -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY' -d '{"model":"rw-opt-8b","seq_len":64}'
```

benchbot: CSV and initial chart PNGs uploaded to /marketing/bench/173210_upload. Will post final chart links when ready.

eli: I'll post a draft one-pager tomorrow AM.

maria: Tasks: ajay = final CSV + chart renders (Wed AM), eli = one-pager + slides (Wed EOD), jen = social + landing (Thu AM), sam = webinar ops + runbook (Thu EOD), noah = SDR routing rules (Thu EOD). Keep messaging tight and testable. :rocket:
